question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Delivery.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context of the sentence, the word** "delivery"** is the most appropriate option as it refers to the act of transporting goods or items from one place to another. The sentence suggests that the e-commerce industry has historically struggled with transporting goods or items from one place to another, indicating that the word "**delivery**" fits well in the blank.

 
 
• Example sentence: The company offers free **delivery **for orders above $50.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) flipping -** This word refers to the act of turning something over quickly or suddenly. It does not fit in the context of the sentence as it does not relate to the transportation of goods.

 
 
• Example sentence: The chef was **flipping **pancakes in the air.
 
 
 
• **2) placing** - This word refers to the act of putting something in a particular position or location. While it is related to the transportation of goods, it does not convey the idea of moving them from one place to another.
 
 
• Example sentence: She was **placing **the books on the shelf.
 
 
 
• **3) storing **- This word refers to the act of keeping something in a particular place for future use. It does not fit in the context of the sentence as it does not relate to the transportation of goods.
 
 
• Example sentence: He was **storing **his winter clothes in the attic.
